title: PlayStation Trophy Trophy Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=psn:trophy trophy_count=*
| stats sum(trophy_count) as total_value, avg(trophy_count) as avg_value by game_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks game values by total and average trophy count across PlayStation trophy events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `trophy_count` values for each PlayStation trophy event and review total and average trophy count by game.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total trophy count.
grandmaExplanation: It will remind which game shows the biggest trophy count numbers in your PlayStation trophy data.
